name: feathercode
description: OpenCode-style lean harness: small system prompt, cache-stable context, OpenCode compaction, build/plan modes, token instrumentation

features.title: Features
features.description: Comma list of enabled features: prompt,cache,tools,modes,agents,compact (or all / observe). Instrumentation is always on. Env FEATHERCODE_FEATURES overrides.

compaction_auto.title: Auto compaction
compaction_auto.description: Compact automatically when the context overflows (OpenCode compaction.auto)

compaction_prune.title: Prune old tool output
compaction_prune.description: Clear old tool outputs at turn end (OpenCode compaction.prune)

tail_turns.title: Tail turns
tail_turns.description: Recent user turns kept verbatim when compacting (OpenCode compaction.tail_turns)

log_dir.title: Log directory
log_dir.description: Where JSONL usage logs go. Empty: ~/.claude/feathercode/logs. Env FEATHERCODE_LOG_DIR overrides.

panel.title: Usage panel
panel.description: Open the token/cache panel at session start where a UI exists
